khadija_bt_khuwaylid.ar: خديجة بنت خويلد بن أسد بن عبد العزى بن قصي بن كلاب بن مرة بن كعب بن لؤي
khadija_bt_khuwaylid.lat: Khadija bint Khuwaylid ibn Asad ibn Abd al-Uzza ibn Qusayy ibn Kilab ibn Murra ibn Kab ibn Luayy
khadija_bt_khuwaylid.note: First to believe, without dispute among the biographers.
khadija_bt_khuwaylid.story: The very first person to believe. She was a respected trader in Makkah, and she stood by the Prophet when almost nobody else would.
khadija_bt_khuwaylid.storyAr: أول من آمن. كانت تاجرة موقّرة في مكة، ووقفت مع النبي ﷺ حين أعرض عنه الناس.
facts: She ran her own trading business, and hired the Prophet ﷺ before they married.
The Prophet ﷺ married no one else while she was alive.
She is called Umm al-Mu'minin, Mother of the Believers.
factsAr: كانت تدير تجارتها بنفسها، واستأجرت النبي ﷺ قبل أن يتزوجها.
لم يتزوج النبي ﷺ غيرها في حياتها.
تُلقَّب بأم المؤمنين.

abu_bakr.ar: عبد الله بن عثمان بن عامر بن عمرو بن كعب بن سعد بن تيم بن مرة بن كعب بن لؤي
abu_bakr.lat: Abdullah ibn Uthman ibn Amir ibn Amr ibn Kab ibn Sad ibn Taym ibn Murra ibn Kab ibn Luayy
abu_bakr.dispute: The sources record competing claims for 'first man', 'first youth' and 'first mawla'. Ibn Hajar and Ibn Abd al-Barr both reconcile these by category rather than choosing one. Present as three parallel firsts, not a single ranking.

abu_bakr.note: First free adult man to accept Islam, per the majority. See dispute_note.
abu_bakr.story: The Prophet's closest friend. He travelled with him on the journey to Madinah and hid with him in the cave of Thawr.
abu_bakr.storyAr: أقرب أصحاب النبي ﷺ إليه. رافقه في الهجرة إلى المدينة، واختبأ معه في غار ثور.
facts: He bought the freedom of Bilal and other enslaved Muslims.
He was the Prophet's ﷺ companion in the cave of Thawr on the hijra.
He became the first caliph after the Prophet ﷺ.
factsAr: اشترى بلالًا وغيره من المستضعفين وأعتقهم.
كان صاحب النبي ﷺ في غار ثور في الهجرة.
صار أول الخلفاء بعد النبي ﷺ.

ali_b_abi_talib.ar: علي بن أبي طالب بن عبد المطلب بن هاشم بن عبد مناف بن قصي بن كلاب بن مرة
ali_b_abi_talib.lat: Ali ibn Abi Talib ibn Abd al-Muttalib ibn Hashim ibn Abd Manaf ibn Qusayy ibn Kilab ibn Murra
ali_b_abi_talib.dispute: See abu_bakr. The ordering of Abu Bakr / Ali / Zayd is resolved by category in the Sunni tabaqat, not by sequence.

ali_b_abi_talib.note: First among the youths; a child in the Prophet's household at the time.
ali_b_abi_talib.story: He grew up in the Prophet's own home and was the first of the young people to believe.
ali_b_abi_talib.storyAr: نشأ في بيت النبي ﷺ، وكان أول من آمن من الفتيان.
facts: He slept in the Prophet's ﷺ bed on the night of the hijra so he could leave safely.
He married Fatima, the Prophet's ﷺ daughter.
He carried the banner at Khaybar.
factsAr: نام في فراش النبي ﷺ ليلة الهجرة حتى يخرج آمنًا.
تزوج فاطمة بنت النبي ﷺ.
حمل الراية يوم خيبر.

zayd_b_haritha.ar: زيد بن حارثة بن شراحيل بن كعب بن عبد العزى الكلبي
zayd_b_haritha.lat: Zayd ibn Haritha ibn Sharahil ibn Kab ibn Abd al-Uzza al-Kalbi
zayd_b_haritha.disputeAr: انظر ما ذُكر عند أبي بكر.
zayd_b_haritha.note: First among the mawali. The only Companion named explicitly in the Quran.
zayd_b_haritha.story: He had been a slave. When his family came to take him home, he chose to stay. He is the only Companion named in the Qur'an.
zayd_b_haritha.storyAr: كان مملوكًا، فلما جاء أهله ليأخذوه اختار البقاء. وهو الصحابي الوحيد الذي ذُكر اسمه في القرآن.
facts: His family found him and offered to buy him back — he chose to stay.
He is the only Companion whose name appears in the Qur'an.
He led the Muslim army at Mu'ta.
factsAr: وجده أهله وعرضوا أن يفدوه، فاختار البقاء.
هو الصحابي الوحيد الذي ورد اسمه في القرآن.
قاد جيش المسلمين في مؤتة.

uthman_b_affan.note: Among the first group brought by Abu Bakr.
uthman_b_affan.story: He gave away a great deal of his wealth, and bought a well in Madinah so that everyone in the city could drink from it for free.

He married two of the Prophet's ﷺ daughters, so he is called Dhu al-Nurayn.
He paid to equip much of the army that set out for Tabuk.
factsAr: اشترى بئر رومة وسبَّل ماءها لأهل المدينة جميعًا.
تزوج ابنتين للنبي ﷺ، فلُقِّب بذي النورين.

facts: He was Khadija's nephew — her brother's son.
He was among the very first handful to believe.
The Prophet ﷺ called him his hawari, his devoted helper.

كان من النفر الأوائل الذين آمنوا.

abd_al_rahman_b_awf.lat: Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf ibn Abd Awf ibn Abd ibn al-Harith ibn Zuhra ibn Kilab
abd_al_rahman_b_awf.story: He arrived in Madinah with nothing. When another man offered to share half of everything he owned, he asked instead to be shown the way to the market.
abd_al_rahman_b_awf.storyAr: قدم المدينة ولا يملك شيئًا، فلما عرض عليه أخوه أن يقاسمه ماله كله، سأله أن يدلّه على السوق.
facts: Offered half of a man's wealth in Madinah, he asked to be shown the market instead.
He was a skilled trader who gave away a great deal of what he earned.
He is one of the ten given glad tidings.
factsAr: عُرض عليه نصف مال أخيه بالمدينة، فسأله أن يدلّه على السوق.
كان تاجرًا ماهرًا، أنفق كثيرًا مما كسب.
هو أحد العشرة المبشرين بالجنة.

sad_b_abi_waqqas.lat: Sad ibn Malik ibn Uhayb ibn Abd Manaf ibn Zuhra ibn Kilab
sad_b_abi_waqqas.dispute: His own claim to be third conflicts with the standard ordering. Recorded in the tabaqat without resolution.
sad_b_abi_waqqas.disputeAr: رُوي عنه أنه قال إنه «ثالث ثلاثة»، وهو يخالف الترتيب المشهور، ونقلت الطبقات القولين دون ترجيح.
sad_b_abi_waqqas.note: Reported to have said he was 'the third of three' to accept Islam.
sad_b_abi_waqqas.story: One of the youngest of the first believers. His mother tried to make him leave Islam, but he stayed firm in his faith and kind to her.
sad_b_abi_waqqas.storyAr: من أصغر السابقين الأولين. حاولت أمه أن تردّه عن الإسلام، فثبت على إيمانه وبرّ بها.
facts: He is said to be the first to shoot an arrow in the path of Islam.
His mother refused food to make him leave Islam; he stayed firm and kept caring for her.
Years later he led the Muslim army at Qadisiyya.
factsAr: يُذكر أنه أول من رمى بسهم في سبيل الإسلام.
امتنعت أمه عن الطعام ليترك دينه، فثبت وبقي بارًّا بها.
قاد بعد سنين جيش المسلمين في القادسية.

People called him al-Fayyad because he gave so freely.
He is one of the ten given glad tidings.
factsAr: وقى النبي ﷺ بنفسه يوم أُحد.
سماه الناس الفيّاض لكثرة عطائه.
هو أحد العشرة المبشرين بالجنة.

facts: He was the first of the emigrants to be buried at al-Baqi in Madinah.
He went on the first journey to Abyssinia.
He wanted to give up all comfort, and the Prophet ﷺ taught him balance instead.

خرج في الهجرة الأولى إلى الحبشة.
أراد ترك كل متاع الدنيا، فعلَّمه النبي ﷺ الاعتدال.

arqam_b_abi_al_arqam.lat: al-Arqam ibn Abd Manaf ibn Asad ibn Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Makhzum
arqam_b_abi_al_arqam.note: His house on Safa was the first base of the community; Dar al-Arqam.
arqam_b_abi_al_arqam.story: He offered his house near Safa as the first safe place where the Muslims could meet and learn together.
arqam_b_abi_al_arqam.storyAr: جعل بيته عند الصفا أول مكان آمن يجتمع فيه المسلمون ويتعلمون.
facts: His house stood on the hill of Safa, close to the Kaaba.
It became the first school of Islam, where the Muslims met in secret.
About forty people are said to have believed while it was their meeting place.
factsAr: كان بيته على الصفا قريبًا من الكعبة.
صار أول مدرسة في الإسلام، يجتمع فيها المسلمون سرًّا.
يُذكر أن نحو أربعين أسلموا في أيام اجتماعهم فيه.

bilal_b_rabah.note: Tortured in Mecca; purchased and freed by Abu Bakr.
bilal_b_rabah.story: He was enslaved and badly treated for believing, until Abu Bakr bought his freedom. He became the first to call people to prayer.
bilal_b_rabah.storyAr: استُعبد وأوذي لأنه آمن، حتى اشتراه أبو بكر فأعتقه. وصار أول من أذّن.
facts: He was laid on the burning sand of Makkah and still would not give up his faith.
He was the first person to call the adhan.
He gave the call to prayer from the Kaaba on the day Makkah was opened.
factsAr: أُلقي على رمضاء مكة فما ترك دينه.
هو أول من أذَّن.
أذَّن عند الكعبة يوم فتح مكة.
events: The call to prayer at the Kaaba

ammar_b_yasir.lat: Ammar ibn Yasir ibn Amir ibn Malik al-Ansi
ammar_b_yasir.note: His parents Yasir and Sumayya were among those killed under torture.
ammar_b_yasir.story: He and his parents were among the first families to suffer for their faith in Makkah.
ammar_b_yasir.storyAr: كان هو وأبواه من أوائل من نالهم الأذى في مكة بسبب إيمانهم.
facts: His mother Sumayya was among the first to die for her faith.
His whole family was hurt in Makkah, and the Prophet ﷺ promised them patience would be rewarded.
He lived a very long life and stayed known for plain speaking.
factsAr: أمه سُميّة من أوائل من قُتلوا في سبيل إيمانهم.
أوذيت أسرته كلها بمكة، ووعدهم النبي ﷺ بالصبر وثوابه.
عاش عمرًا طويلًا وعُرف بصراحته.

said_b_zayd.lat: Said ibn Zayd ibn Amr ibn Nufayl ibn Abd al-Uzza ibn Riyah ibn Abdullah ibn Qurt ibn Razah ibn Adi ibn Kab
said_b_zayd.note: Cousin and brother-in-law of Umar; his conversion preceded Umar's.
said_b_zayd.story: Umar's cousin. He believed before Umar did.
said_b_zayd.storyAr: ابن عمّ عمر، وقد آمن قبله.
facts: His father Zayd ibn Amr searched for the religion of Ibrahim before Islam came.
He believed before Umar, who was his cousin.
He is one of the ten given glad tidings.
factsAr: كان أبوه زيد بن عمرو يطلب دين إبراهيم قبل الإسلام.
آمن قبل عمر، وهو ابن عمه.
هو أحد العشرة المبشرين بالجنة.

fatima_bt_al_khattab.lat: Fatima bint al-Khattab ibn Nufayl ibn Abd al-Uzza ibn Riyah
fatima_bt_al_khattab.note: Sister of Umar, wife of Said ibn Zayd. The scene at her house is the pivot of Umar's conversion narrative.
fatima_bt_al_khattab.story: Umar's sister. He came to her house angry, but what he heard and read there changed his heart.
fatima_bt_al_khattab.storyAr: أخت عمر. جاء إلى بيتها غاضبًا، فغيّر قلبه ما سمعه وقرأه هناك.
facts: She and her husband kept their faith secret from her brother Umar.
Umar came to her house angry, and left it a believer.
She was reading a page of the Qur'an when he arrived.
factsAr: أخفت هي وزوجها إسلامهما عن أخيها عمر.
جاء عمر إلى بيتها غاضبًا، فخرج منه مؤمنًا.
كانت تقرأ صحيفة من القرآن حين دخل.

jafar_b_abi_talib.lat: Jafar ibn Abi Talib ibn Abd al-Muttalib ibn Hashim ibn Abd Manaf ibn Qusayy
jafar_b_abi_talib.note: Led the emigrants in Abyssinia and spoke before the Negus.
jafar_b_abi_talib.story: He led the Muslims who travelled to Abyssinia and spoke for them before its king.
jafar_b_abi_talib.storyAr: قاد المسلمين الذين هاجروا إلى الحبشة، وتكلم عنهم بين يدي ملكها.
facts: He looked like the Prophet ﷺ and behaved like him too.
He answered the king of Abyssinia when Quraysh demanded the Muslims be sent back.
He is remembered as Dhu al-Janahayn, the one with two wings.
factsAr: كان أشبه الناس بالنبي ﷺ خَلْقًا وخُلُقًا.
أجاب ملك الحبشة حين طلبت قريش ردّ المسلمين.
يُذكر بذي الجناحين.

abu_salama.lat: Abdullah ibn Abd al-Asad ibn Hilal ibn Abdullah ibn Umar ibn Makhzum
abu_salama.story: One of the first to make the journey to Abyssinia for safety.
abu_salama.storyAr: من أوائل من هاجر إلى الحبشة طلبًا للأمان.
facts: He was among the first to travel to Abyssinia for safety.
He was married to Umm Salama, who later became a Mother of the Believers.
He was wounded at Uhud and passed away from it.
factsAr: من أوائل من هاجر إلى الحبشة طلبًا للأمان.
كان زوج أم سلمة، التي صارت بعدُ من أمهات المؤمنين.
أصيب يوم أُحد ثم مات من جرحه.

abdullah_b_masud.lat: Abdullah ibn Masud ibn Ghafil ibn Habib al-Hudhali
abdullah_b_masud.dispute: The 'sixth of six' report conflicts with other orderings in the same works.

abdullah_b_masud.note: Said to be the sixth to accept Islam. First to recite the Quran aloud publicly in Mecca.
abdullah_b_masud.story: The first person to recite the Qur'an out loud in Makkah, and later one of its greatest teachers.
abdullah_b_masud.storyAr: أول من جهر بالقرآن في مكة، ثم صار من أعظم من علّمه.
facts: He was a shepherd boy when he first met the Prophet ﷺ.
He was the first to recite the Qur'an out loud in front of Quraysh.
The Prophet ﷺ praised the beauty of his recitation.
factsAr: كان راعي غنم حين لقي النبي ﷺ أول مرة.
أول من جهر بالقرآن أمام قريش.
أثنى النبي ﷺ على حسن قراءته.

khabbab_b_al_aratt.lat: Khabbab ibn al-Aratt ibn Jandala al-Tamimi
khabbab_b_al_aratt.story: A blacksmith who was hurt for his faith in Makkah and stayed patient through it.
khabbab_b_al_aratt.storyAr: حدّاد أوذي في مكة بسبب إيمانه فصبر.
facts: He worked as a blacksmith in Makkah.
He was among the first handful of people to believe.
He asked the Prophet ﷺ to pray for relief, and was told to be patient.
factsAr: كان حدّادًا بمكة.
من النفر الأوائل الذين آمنوا.
سأل النبي ﷺ أن يدعو لهم، فأُمر بالصبر.

suhayb_al_rumi.lat: Suhayb ibn Sinan ibn Malik al-Namari
suhayb_al_rumi.note: Bought his freedom to emigrate, surrendering his wealth to Quraysh.
suhayb_al_rumi.story: He handed over everything he owned to Quraysh so that they would let him leave for Madinah.
suhayb_al_rumi.storyAr: ترك ماله كله لقريش حتى أذنوا له بالهجرة إلى المدينة.
facts: He grew up in Byzantine lands, which is why he is called al-Rumi.
Quraysh let him leave for Madinah only after he handed over all his wealth.
Umar said that a trade like that had truly profited him.
factsAr: نشأ في بلاد الروم، ولذلك قيل له الرومي.
لم تأذن له قريش بالهجرة حتى ترك مالَه كله.
قال عمر: ربح البيع.

abu_dharr_al_ghifari.lat: Jundub ibn Junada ibn Sufyan al-Ghifari
abu_dharr_al_ghifari.note: Came to Mecca seeking the Prophet; returned to his tribe and brought them to Islam.
abu_dharr_al_ghifari.story: He travelled to Makkah to find the Prophet, then went home and taught his whole tribe.
abu_dharr_al_ghifari.storyAr: سافر إلى مكة يبحث عن النبي ﷺ، ثم عاد فعلّم قومه كلهم.
facts: He came to Makkah as a stranger, searching for the Prophet ﷺ.
He announced his faith openly at the Kaaba on his very first day.
He went home and brought his whole tribe, Ghifar, to Islam.
factsAr: قدم مكة غريبًا يبحث عن النبي ﷺ.
أعلن إسلامه عند الكعبة في أول يوم.
رجع إلى قومه فأسلمت غفار كلها.

umar_b_al_khattab.ar: عمر بن الخطاب بن نفيل بن عبد العزى بن رياح بن عبد الله بن قرط بن رزاح بن عدي بن كعب
umar_b_al_khattab.lat: Umar ibn al-Khattab ibn Nufayl ibn Abd al-Uzza ibn Riyah ibn Abdullah ibn Qurt ibn Razah ibn Adi ibn Kab
umar_b_al_khattab.note: Converted in year 6 of the mission; the community numbered roughly forty at the time.
umar_b_al_khattab.story: He set out meaning to harm the Prophet, but stopped at his sister's house on the way and became a believer instead.
umar_b_al_khattab.storyAr: خرج يريد أذى النبي ﷺ، فمرّ في طريقه ببيت أخته، فآمن.
facts: When he believed, the Muslims prayed openly at the Kaaba for the first time.
He is called al-Faruq, the one who tells right from wrong.
He became the second caliph and was known for his fairness.
factsAr: لما أسلم، صلى المسلمون عند الكعبة جهرًا لأول مرة.
لُقِّب بالفاروق، لأنه يفرّق بين الحق والباطل.
صار الخليفة الثاني، وعُرف بعدله.

hamza_b_abd_al_muttalib.note: Uncle of the Prophet; converted shortly before Umar.
hamza_b_abd_al_muttalib.story: The Prophet's uncle, remembered for his courage.
facts: He was the Prophet's ﷺ uncle, and close to him in age.
He was nursed as a baby by the same woman as the Prophet ﷺ.
He is remembered as Sayyid al-Shuhada, and died at Uhud.
factsAr: عمّ النبي ﷺ، وكان قريبًا منه في السن.
أرضعته في صغره المرأة التي أرضعت النبي ﷺ.

musab_b_umayr.ar: مصعب بن عمير بن هاشم بن عبد مناف بن عبد الدار بن قصي
musab_b_umayr.lat: Musab ibn Umayr ibn Hashim ibn Abd Manaf ibn Abd al-Dar ibn Qusayy
musab_b_umayr.note: Sent to Medina after the first Aqaba pledge as the first teacher there.
musab_b_umayr.story: He grew up with fine clothes and comfort and gave it all up. He was sent ahead to Madinah as its first teacher.
musab_b_umayr.storyAr: نشأ في نعمة ولين عيش فتركها، وأُرسل إلى المدينة ليكون أول معلّم فيها.
facts: He was known as the best-dressed young man in Makkah before he believed.
The Prophet ﷺ sent him to Madinah as its first teacher.
He carried the banner at Uhud.
factsAr: كان أنعم فتى بمكة وأحسنهم لباسًا قبل إسلامه.
أرسله النبي ﷺ إلى المدينة ليكون أول معلّم فيها.
حمل الراية يوم أُحد.

asad_b_zurara.note: Among the earliest of the Ansar; a naqib at the second pledge.
asad_b_zurara.story: One of the first people of Madinah to believe, and one of the twelve chosen leaders.
asad_b_zurara.storyAr: من أوائل أهل المدينة إيمانًا، وأحد النقباء الاثني عشر.
facts: He led the first Friday prayer in Madinah before the Prophet ﷺ arrived.
He was one of the twelve chosen leaders at Aqaba.
He was the first of the twelve to pass away.
factsAr: صلى بأهل المدينة أول جمعة قبل قدوم النبي ﷺ.
كان أحد النقباء الاثني عشر ليلة العقبة.
أول من مات من النقباء.

ubada_b_al_samit.lat: Ubada ibn al-Samit ibn Qays ibn Asram al-Khazraji
ubada_b_al_samit.note: Present at both Aqaba pledges; one of the twelve nuqaba.
ubada_b_al_samit.story: He was at both meetings at Aqaba, and was chosen as one of the twelve leaders of his people.

facts: He was present at both pledges at Aqaba.
He was chosen as one of the twelve leaders of the Ansar.
He later taught the Qur'an to people in Sham.
factsAr: شهد بيعتي العقبة كلتيهما.
اختير نقيبًا من نقباء الأنصار الاثني عشر.
علَّم الناس القرآن بعدُ في الشام.
events: Chosen as one of the twelve

sad_b_muadh.lat: Sad ibn Muadh ibn al-Numan ibn Imru al-Qays al-Awsi
sad_b_muadh.note: Converted through Musab ibn Umayr; his clan followed him in a single day.
sad_b_muadh.story: When he believed, his whole clan followed him the very same day.
sad_b_muadh.storyAr: لمّا آمن، أسلمت قبيلته كلها في اليوم نفسه.
facts: His clan, Banu Abd al-Ashhal, all believed on the day he did.
He was chosen to judge in the matter of Banu Qurayza.
The Prophet ﷺ said the Throne of the Merciful shook at his passing.
factsAr: أسلمت قبيلته بنو عبد الأشهل كلها في اليوم الذي أسلم فيه.
اختير حكمًا في أمر بني قريظة.
قال النبي ﷺ: اهتز عرش الرحمن لموته.

sad_b_ubada.lat: Sad ibn Ubada ibn Dulaym ibn Haritha al-Khazraji
sad_b_ubada.note: One of the twelve nuqaba; standard-bearer of the Ansar.
sad_b_ubada.story: A leader of the Khazraj, known for feeding guests so generously that people told stories about it.
sad_b_ubada.storyAr: سيّد من سادات الخزرج، عُرف بكرمه في إطعام الضيف حتى تحدّث الناس عنه.

His family was famous for feeding guests, generation after generation.
He carried the banner of the Ansar.
factsAr: كان سيدًا من سادات الخزرج في الجاهلية والإسلام.
اشتهر بيته بإطعام الضيف جيلًا بعد جيل.
حمل راية الأنصار.

abu_ayyub_al_ansari.lat: Khalid ibn Zayd ibn Kulayb ibn Thalaba al-Najjari al-Khazraji
abu_ayyub_al_ansari.note: Hosted the Prophet in Medina until the mosque and quarters were built.
abu_ayyub_al_ansari.story: When the Prophet arrived in Madinah, he stayed in Abu Ayyub's house until his own was built.

facts: Everyone in Madinah wanted to host the Prophet ﷺ, so he let his camel choose — it knelt at Abu Ayyub's door.
The Prophet ﷺ stayed in his house until his own home was built.
He kept travelling and serving into great old age.
factsAr: تنافس أهل المدينة على ضيافة النبي ﷺ، فترك ناقته تختار، فبركت عند باب أبي أيوب.
نزل النبي ﷺ في بيته حتى بُني بيته.
ظل يخرج ويجاهد حتى كبرت سنّه.

sad_b_al_rabi.lat: Sad ibn al-Rabi ibn Amr al-Khazraji
sad_b_al_rabi.note: One of the twelve nuqaba chosen at the second pledge.
sad_b_al_rabi.story: A leader of the Khazraj, chosen as one of the twelve nuqaba on the night of Aqaba.
sad_b_al_rabi.storyAr: قائد من الخزرج، اختير أحد النقباء الاثني عشر ليلة العقبة.
facts: He was one of the twelve chosen to represent their people at the second pledge.
He was from the Khazraj clan of Banu al-Harith.

He was one of the twelve nuqaba chosen at Aqaba.
He was killed at Mu'ta, leading the army after two other commanders had fallen.
factsAr: كان يرد بشعره على من يهجو النبي ﷺ.
كان أحد النقباء الاثني عشر ليلة العقبة.

rafi_b_malik.note: Present at the first pledge as well as the second; one of the twelve nuqaba.

facts: He is said to have carried the first verses of the Qur'an back to Madinah after the first pledge.
He attended both the first and second pledges at Aqaba.
He was one of the twelve nuqaba, from Banu Zurayq.
factsAr: يُذكر أنه أول من حمل شيئًا من القرآن إلى المدينة بعد العقبة الأولى.

al_bara_b_marur.lat: al-Bara ibn Marur ibn Sakhr al-Khazraji
al_bara_b_marur.note: A leading elder of his clan and one of the twelve nuqaba. Died in Madinah shortly before the Prophet's own arrival there.
al_bara_b_marur.story: An elder of his clan and one of the twelve nuqaba. He passed away in Madinah just before the Prophet arrived there.

facts: He was one of the senior elders among the Khazraj who accepted Islam.
He asked to be buried facing the direction the Prophet ﷺ prayed toward.
He passed away in Madinah before the Prophet ﷺ himself arrived.
factsAr: كان من كبار شيوخ الخزرج الذين أسلموا.
طلب أن يُدفن مستقبلًا القبلة التي كان النبي ﷺ يصلي إليها.
توفي بالمدينة قبل أن يصلها النبي ﷺ.

abdullah_b_amr_b_haram.note: One of the twelve nuqaba, and father of the later hadith narrator Jabir ibn Abdullah.

facts: He was one of the twelve nuqaba chosen at the second pledge.
His son Jabir ibn Abdullah became one of the most prolific narrators of hadith.
He was killed at Uhud, and the Prophet ﷺ spoke of his reward.
factsAr: كان أحد النقباء الاثني عشر ليلة العقبة الثانية.
صار ابنه جابر بن عبد الله من أكثر الصحابة رواية للحديث.
استشهد يوم أُحد، وتحدث النبي ﷺ عن أجره.

He was killed at the well of Mauna, defending a group of Muslim teachers who had been betrayed.

He is also known by his kunya, Abu Lubaba.
He was sent back from partway to Badr to look after Madinah, and the Prophet ﷺ still counted him among those present.
factsAr: كان أحد النقباء الاثني عشر ليلة العقبة، من الأوس.
يُعرف أيضًا بكنيته أبي لبابة.
أُعيد من الطريق إلى بدر ليرعى شؤون المدينة، وعدّه النبي ﷺ ممن شهدها.

facts: She is also known as Umm Umara.
She was one of only two women present at the second pledge of Aqaba, given orally.
At Uhud, she fought to defend the Prophet ﷺ when the lines broke.
factsAr: تُعرف أيضًا بأم عمارة.

قاتلت يوم أُحد دفاعًا عن النبي ﷺ حين انكشف الصف.

asma_bt_amr.storyAr: واحدة من امرأتين فقط شهدتا بيعة العقبة الثانية.
facts: She was one of only two women present at the second pledge of Aqaba.
Like the other pledgers, she gave her word to support the Prophet ﷺ in Madinah.
She belonged to the Khazraj of Madinah.
factsAr: كانت إحدى امرأتين فقط شهدتا بيعة العقبة الثانية.
بايعت مع من بايع على نصرة النبي ﷺ في المدينة.
كانت من الخزرج بالمدينة.

facts: When warned of the risks, he was among those who told the Prophet ﷺ they would stand firm.
He was present at Badr and Uhud.
He belonged to Banu Abd al-Ashhal of the Aws.
factsAr: حين حُذِّروا من المخاطر، كان ممن قال للنبي ﷺ إنهم على العهد ثابتون.
شهد بدرًا وأُحدًا.
كان من بني عبد الأشهل من الأوس.

He was a poet, alongside Hassan ibn Thabit and Abdullah ibn Rawaha.
He belonged to Banu Salama of the Khazraj.

كان من بني سلمة من الخزرج.

abu_hudhayfa_b_utba.note: An early convert who emigrated to Abyssinia; son of the Qurayshi chief Utba ibn Rabia, though he took the side of faith against his own father's people.
abu_hudhayfa_b_utba.story: An early believer who emigrated to Abyssinia. His father was a chief of Quraysh, yet he stood with the faith rather than his own people.
abu_hudhayfa_b_utba.storyAr: من السابقين إلى الإسلام، هاجر إلى الحبشة، وثبت على إيمانه وإن كان أبوه من سادة قريش.
facts: His full given name was Qays; he is almost always called by his kunya, Abu Hudhayfa.
He was among those who made the first emigration to Abyssinia.
He was killed at the Battle of al-Yamama, in the year 12 AH.
factsAr: اسمه قيس، لكنه يُعرف دائمًا بكنيته أبي حذيفة.
كان من المهاجرين في الهجرة الأولى إلى الحبشة.
استشهد يوم اليمامة سنة اثنتي عشرة للهجرة.

sahla_bt_suhayl.lat: Sahla bint Suhayl ibn Amr al-Amiriyya
sahla_bt_suhayl.note: Wife of Abu Hudhayfa ibn Utba; emigrated with him to Abyssinia. Daughter of the Qurayshi statesman Suhayl ibn Amr.
sahla_bt_suhayl.story: The wife of Abu Hudhayfa ibn Utba, who emigrated with him to Abyssinia. Her father was the Qurayshi statesman Suhayl ibn Amr.

facts: She emigrated to Abyssinia with her husband, Abu Hudhayfa ibn Utba.
Her father was Suhayl ibn Amr, a leading man of Quraysh.
She was of the clan of Banu Amir ibn Luayy.
factsAr: هاجرت إلى الحبشة مع زوجها أبي حذيفة بن عتبة.
أبوها سهيل بن عمرو، من سادة قريش.
كانت من بني عامر بن لؤي.

umm_salama.ar: أم سلمة هند بنت أبي أمية بن المغيرة المخزومية
umm_salama.lat: Hind bint Abi Umayya ibn al-Mughira al-Makhzumiyya
umm_salama.note: Wife of Abu Salama; emigrated with him to Abyssinia. After his death she married the Prophet and became one of the Mothers of the Believers.
umm_salama.story: She emigrated with her husband Abu Salama to Abyssinia. After his death she married the Prophet and became one of the Mothers of the Believers.
umm_salama.storyAr: هاجرت مع زوجها أبي سلمة إلى الحبشة، ثم صارت بعد وفاته من أمهات المؤمنين.
facts: Her given name was Hind; she is known by her kunya, Umm Salama.
She emigrated twice — first to Abyssinia, then later to Madinah.
After the death of Abu Salama she became a wife of the Prophet and a Mother of the Believers.
factsAr: اسمها هند، وتُعرف بكنيتها أم سلمة.
هاجرت مرتين: إلى الحبشة أولًا، ثم إلى المدينة.
بعد وفاة أبي سلمة صارت من أزواج النبي وأمهات المؤمنين.

amir_b_rabia.ar: عامر بن ربيعة العنزي حليف بني عدي
amir_b_rabia.note: An early convert and confederate (halif) of Banu Adi, of the tribe of Anz rather than Quraysh by blood; emigrated to Abyssinia with his wife Layla.
amir_b_rabia.story: An early believer and confederate of Banu Adi, from the tribe of Anz. He emigrated to Abyssinia with his wife Layla.
amir_b_rabia.storyAr: من السابقين، وحليف بني عدي، هاجر إلى الحبشة مع زوجته ليلى.
facts: He was from the tribe of Anz, and a confederate (halif) of Banu Adi rather than a Qurayshi by blood.
He and his wife Layla were among the emigrants to Abyssinia.
He later fought at Badr.
factsAr: كان من قبيلة عنز، وحليفًا لبني عدي لا قرشيًا بالنسب.
كان هو وزوجته ليلى من المهاجرين إلى الحبشة.
شهد بدرًا فيما بعد.

facts: She was the wife of Amir ibn Rabia.
She is remembered as among the first women to emigrate to Abyssinia.
Her kunya was Umm Abdullah.
factsAr: كانت زوجة عامر بن ربيعة.
تُذكر أنها من أوائل النساء هجرةً إلى الحبشة.
كنيتها أم عبد الله.

facts: He was known by his mother's name, Bayda, rather than his father's.
He emigrated to Abyssinia and stayed there for a time.
He fought at Badr beside his brother Safwan, at about thirty-four years of age.
factsAr: عُرف باسم أمه بيضاء لا باسم أبيه.
هاجر إلى الحبشة وأقام بها مدة.
شهد بدرًا مع أخيه صفوان وعمره نحو أربع وثلاثين سنة.
